::: {.callout-warning title="Preliminary output"}

This report is preliminary; all data and estimates in this study are provisional.
It documents the **recorded** Down syndrome (DS) population only, births with
`down_ind = 1` (`ca_down_c ∈ {C confirmed, P pending}`). Classifier-cohort reports describe a separate selected population. Bayesian
models estimate expected population counts under external-data assumptions.
Methods and benchmark limits are in the repository
[descriptive guide](https://github.com/dspopulations/us-birth-certificates/blob/main/docs/analysis/descriptive.md).

:::

```{python}
# | echo: false
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from dspopulations_us_birth_certificates.report_readers import read_csv_artefact, read_json_artefact
from IPython.display import Markdown

config = read_json_artefact(Path("config.json"))


def _table(csv: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return read_csv_artefact(csv)


def _pct(frac: float) -> str:
    return f"{frac * 100:.1f}%"
```

```{python}
# | echo: false
Markdown(
    f"This report covers **{config['total_births']:,}** US live births "
    f"({config['year_min']}–{config['year_max']}), of which "
    f"**{config['total_recorded']:,}** were recorded with Down syndrome. "
    f"The recorded-to-surveillance-expected ratio is "
    f"**{_pct(config['overall_recording_rate'])}**. This benchmark ratio depends "
    f"on the external expected-count series. "
    f"Generated {config['generated_at']}."
)
```

# Recorded numbers and trends

The plots show annual counts and rates from the current run. "Pending" (`P`)
begins in 2004. The confirmed-only line avoids that added category but remains
subject to changes in ascertainment. Revised-certificate coverage was complete
in 2016; the shaded 2003–2013 band marks the earlier transition years.

![Recorded DS live births by confirmation status, with the confirmed-only line and the 2003–2013 transition band.](recorded_confirmed_pending.png){#fig-confirmed-pending .lightbox fig-align="center"}

![Recorded DS per 10,000 live births. The rate reflects both true prevalence and recording.](recorded_rate_per_10k.png){#fig-rate .lightbox fig-align="center"}

The "unknown" (`U`) and absent-item (NULL) series show status availability.
The report includes these births in its all-birth denominator but not its
recorded numerator. The database retains NULL in `down_ind`; Bayesian cohorts
can exclude those births.

![DS item recorded as Unknown or absent from the certificate.](ds_status_unknown.png){#fig-unknown .lightbox fig-align="center"}

```{python}
# | echo: false
# | label: tbl-status
_status = _table("recorded_by_status.csv")
_disp = _status[
    ["year", "confirmed", "pending", "unknown", "not_on_cert", "births",
     "recorded_ds", "recorded_per_10k"]
].copy()
for c in ["confirmed", "pending", "unknown", "not_on_cert", "births", "recorded_ds"]:
    _disp[c] = _disp[c].map(lambda v: f"{int(v):,}")
_disp["recorded_per_10k"] = _disp["recorded_per_10k"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.2f}")
_disp = _disp.rename(columns={
    "year": "Year", "confirmed": "C", "pending": "P", "unknown": "U",
    "not_on_cert": "Not on cert", "births": "Births",
    "recorded_ds": "Recorded DS", "recorded_per_10k": "Per 10k",
}).set_index("Year")
_disp
```

# Recorded vs surveillance-expected

The plots compare recorded counts with external expected-count benchmarks. Their
gap depends on the benchmark, its population and its assumptions. It does not
independently measure missed cases or recording sensitivity.

`p_ds_lb_wt` holds the 2018 surveillance prevalence through 2024.
`p_ds_lb_nt_reduc` applies the annual reduction series to the Morris age-risk
curve. That series has an extrapolated tail. See the
[methods guide](https://github.com/dspopulations/us-birth-certificates/blob/main/docs/analysis/descriptive.md).

![Recorded vs surveillance-expected DS live births. The benchmarks use different assumptions.](recorded_vs_expected.png){#fig-recorded-expected .lightbox fig-align="center"}

![Recorded-to-expected benchmark ratio over time. The shaded band is a reference assumption.](recording_rate_by_year.png){#fig-recording-rate .lightbox fig-align="center"}

The group plot uses each group's age-risk expected count as a denominator.
Differences can reflect prenatal reduction, recording, false positives or
benchmark mismatch. The ratio is not a separate estimate of group sensitivity.

![Recorded-to-expected ratio by maternal race / Hispanic origin (3-year rolling mean; age-risk expected denominator).](recording_rate_by_race.png){#fig-recording-race .lightbox fig-align="center"}

# Maternal characteristics

The plots compare recorded prevalence by maternal age and the mean and median
age of mothers in recorded DS births with those in all births. These summaries
describe the current run's birth cohort.

![Recorded DS rate by single-year maternal age.](recorded_ds_by_mage.png){#fig-mage .lightbox fig-align="center"}

![Mean and median maternal age: recorded DS births vs all births.](mean_mage_by_year.png){#fig-mean-age .lightbox fig-align="center"}

![Recorded DS births by maternal race / Hispanic origin (5-category; multi-race is identifiable only from 2014 and is not shown here).](recorded_ds_by_race.png){#fig-race-share .lightbox fig-align="center"}

Maternal education cannot be pooled across the 2003 certificate change (years of
schooling pre-2003 vs attainment level 2003+), so it is shown as two panels.

![Maternal education of recorded DS births over time, two non-poolable schemes (years of schooling, 1989–2002; attainment level, 2014–2024), each collapsed to four bands.](recorded_ds_by_education.png){#fig-education .lightbox fig-align="center"}

![Marital status of recorded DS mothers: share married (`dmar`/`mar` coalesced).](recorded_ds_by_marital.png){#fig-marital .lightbox fig-align="center"}

![Principal source of payment of recorded DS births over time (2014–2024).](recorded_ds_by_payer.png){#fig-payer .lightbox fig-align="center"}

# Pregnancy and infant characteristics

The plots compare birth weight, gestation and infant sex in recorded DS births
and all births. These are 2003-certificate items
(`DBIRWT`/`GESTAT10`/`CSEX` pre-2003 are not loaded), so these begin in 2003.

![Birth weight: recorded DS vs all births (2003–2024).](recorded_ds_birthweight.png){#fig-birthweight .lightbox fig-align="center"}

![Gestational age: recorded DS vs all births (2003–2024).](recorded_ds_gestation.png){#fig-gestation .lightbox fig-align="center"}

![Infant sex: recorded DS births vs all births, share male (2003–2024).](recorded_ds_sex.png){#fig-sex .lightbox fig-align="center"}

# Co-occurring conditions and newborn morbidity

The percentages use recorded DS cases with known `Y`/`N` condition status.
They describe checkbox co-recording in that selected group. They are not
necessarily lower bounds for all DS births. The cyanotic-heart-disease checkbox
is narrower than all congenital heart defects, so an all-defect clinical estimate
is not a like-for-like benchmark.

![Co-occurring conditions among recorded DS births (2014–2024, % of the Y/N base).](recorded_ds_co_occurring.png){#fig-co-occurring .lightbox fig-align="center"}

```{python}
# | echo: false
# | label: tbl-co-occurring
_co = _table("recorded_ds_co_occurring.csv").sort_values("pct", ascending=False)
_co["pct"] = _co["pct"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.2f}%")
_co[["condition", "pct"]].rename(
    columns={"condition": "Condition", "pct": "% of recorded DS"}
).set_index("Condition")
```

![Newborn morbidity among recorded DS births over time (2014–2024).](recorded_ds_morbidity.png){#fig-morbidity .lightbox fig-align="center"}

# Limitations

The extract covers live births. It has no state identifier, linked later outcomes
or Down syndrome subtype. Several earlier source fields are not imported, and
revised items have partial coverage during the certificate phase-in. Recorded-case
characteristics can differ from those of all DS births.

Expected-count benchmarks use carry-forward and extrapolation assumptions. A
recorded-to-expected ratio does not independently establish sensitivity. See the
[methods guide](https://github.com/dspopulations/us-birth-certificates/blob/main/docs/analysis/descriptive.md)
and [data preparation](https://github.com/dspopulations/us-birth-certificates/blob/main/docs/data-preparation.md).
